Cors.// note: Local frontend origins. Deployed environments set these per environment; never wildcard.

Media.// note: Local MinIO (docker compose). Deployed environments point at DigitalOcean Spaces and supply credentials from the environment, never from a committed file.

Email.// note: Host-run default is 'log'; docker-compose overrides to 'smtp' against Mailpit. Never a real relay from a dev machine.

Emails.// note: Where a confirmation link points: the app, because a person clicking it expects a page.
